title: Design System: HN Architects & Interior Designers

invitation.purpose: Restrained opening invitation in Instrument Sans.

body.purpose: Self-hosted Instrument Sans for reading and controls.

photo-index.purpose: Actual scene, project and photograph indices; tabular numerals.

motion.name: page-out
motion.purpose: Supported cross-document View Transition opacity exit.

motion.name: page-in
motion.purpose: Supported cross-document View Transition opacity entrance.

motion.name: state-feedback
motion.purpose: Viewer cues, header ground, underlines, arrows and disclosure marks.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none; transition: none; scroll-behavior: auto

components.name: Fixed navigation
components.description: Original logo, four anchor links, brass active feedback and readable photographic header scrim.

components.name: Photographic chapters
components.description: Native sticky Threshold, Room and Detail scenes with responsive chapter rail and progressive active-scene tracking.

components.name: Project reel
components.description: Native details/summary with project name, category, index, plus/minus mark and photographic spread; Residence starts open.

components.name: Line action
components.description: Transparent brass-baseline action, minimum 44px high, with directional arrow.

components.name: Full-frame photograph viewer
components.description: Native modal dialog with contained image, caption, count, 44px previous/next controls, arrow-key navigation and Escape/Close dismissal; direct-image fallback.

components.name: Construction disclosure
components.description: Native construction-image disclosure with two desktop columns and one mobile column; construction hash opens it when enhanced.

components.name: Local brief
components.description: Labeled baseline fields with native validation and local plain-text download; sends no data, hidden without JavaScript.
